messages:
chen: CI red on main after the constraints merge. ubuntu-latest integration job failing, not just flakes. anyone on infra who can triage?

infra-ci-bot: Build #7821 failed on ubuntu-20.04 — 47 failing tests. Full log: https://ci.internal/build/7821 (short snippet below)

infra-ci-bot: ```
E   ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'httpcore._backends'
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
ImportError: cannot import name 'Retry' from 'urllib3.util.retry'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/integration/test_http_pool.py", line 12, in test_pool
    from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
ImportError: cannot import name 'Retry' from 'urllib3.util.retry'
```

sam: re-ran the CI job manually, same stack. looks like import paths changed rather than network flake.

alex: Hm, that points to a urllib3/requests/httpcore combo mismatch. Did we regenerate the lockfile or bump constraints yesterday?

maria: we merged the constraints PR from infra-team yesterday afternoon (commit 0a1b2c). It pulled in a newer urllib3 via a transitive pin from requests->httpcore in the constraints refresh.

chen: can someone do a quick bisect on the lockfile commits? if it's a transitive bump we can either pin back or do a targeted revert until we sort compatibility.

devops: I can take this. plan: locally reproduce with poetry v1.5, run `poetry install --no-dev` then run the failing test subset (tests/integration/test_http_pool.py). if repros I'll run a git bisect across the last 8 constraint updates.

devops: repro steps I'm using:
```bash
git checkout main
git pull origin main
poetry env use python3.10
poetry install --no-root --no-dev
pytest tests/integration/test_http_pool.py -q
```

sam: if you confirm urllib3 is newer, a quick mitigation is to add a temporary pin in constraints to urllib3==1.26.16 (or whatever last known good) and open a rollback PR.

alex: Also double-check that httpcore/httpx wheels are the ones expected on ubuntu-latest (many builds pick up different binary wheels). Could be a changed extras/optional dependency resolution.

maria: devops — please post the bisect result here. if bisect shows the constraints merge, i'll open the pin rollback and coordinate a hotfix release to unblock.

devops: running bisect now, will post back in ~20m. if anyone wants to try a faster repro: you can create an ephemeral container with the exact constraint install: `docker run --rm -it python:3.10 /bin/bash -c "apt update && apt install -y build-essential && pip install poetry && ..."` but i'm using local VM to avoid Docker variance.

infra-ci-bot: Re-run requested by @sam on Build #7821 queued.

chen: thanks — @devops please tag the rollback PR with `hotfix/ci` if it's the constraints commit. also ping support so they can triage any customer-facing errors.

devops: bisect found the breaking change: commit 0a1b2c (constraints refresh) — it bumped urllib3 via transitive from requests. I'll open a revert PR to pin urllib3 to the previous version and include a short note to follow up with an invariant test for requests+httpx combos.

maria: perfect. once PR is up i'll request the hotfix merge. thanks for the quick triage everyone :thumbsup:

chen: great job. post-merge let's add a short CI job that runs a minimal compatibility matrix for requests/urllib3/httpx on ubuntu to catch this earlier.

sam: noted — i'll draft the CI matrix ticket after the rollback.

devops: PR: https://git.internal/pkgs/constraints/pull/128 — pins urllib3, adds a changelog entry. tagging for review now.

infra-ci-bot: Build #7833 triggered for branch constraints/revert-urllib3-pin.

chen: marking this resolved for now, will follow up on the compatibility job.

(ended)
